scope: Synthetic production-component browser controls, not native PDF conformance

historical_failure.scenario: unsupported archival output is disabled with its native capability reason

source_inspection.native_reason: PDF/A-2b requires the archival-capable native renderer in this build.
source_inspection.trace: elementState for disabled calls retarget with follow-label. OPTION is absent from the exempt control selector. Its enclosing label targets the enabled SELECT, so the API checks that SELECT instead of the OPTION.

replacement_acceptance: Retain the original isDisabled observation in archival-option-state.json
Require the actual HTMLOptionElement.disabled property and :disabled pseudo-class
Require the parent SELECT to remain enabled for supported formats
Use real keyboard ArrowUp/ArrowDown to prove navigation works but cannot enter pdfa after docx
Require the exact native capability reason and zero export calls
